content.name: X4VRMOD head-look write
content.description: Sets X4's cockpit look-around follower speed to zero, so the view holds whatever angle X4VRMOD writes instead of springing back to centre. Used only by X4VRMOD's X4VR_HEADLOOK_WRITE mode, which enables it for that session; disabled by default. While it is active the numpad camera keys do not turn the cockpit view. Remove by deleting this directory.
content.author: X4VRMOD
